cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook's Nov. 18 article surfaces Jermell Charlo's criticism of Tszyu, but Charlo is an interested participant on the same card and that opinion is treated as contrary evidence rather than a neutral technical forecast. PBC's official event release confirms Lara (32-3-3, 19 KOs) as the 43-year-old, 160-lb southpaw champion with a 75-inch reach; Tszyu (28-3, 18 KOs) is 32, listed at 154 lb with a 70.5-inch reach, and arrives after three consecutive wins including the Errol Spence decision. Tszyu has home support and a meaningful age advantage, but this is his first 160-lb world-title challenge against a proven middleweight. Oddschecker lists Lara 5/6, draw 16/1 and Tszyu 11/10; removing the three-way overround puts Tszyu near 44.1%, or approximately +127 fair. The current +110 aggregator reference does not compensate for the move up in weight and Lara's technical/reach edge.
